question: Which customer has the highest average monthly change in payment amounts? Provide the customer's full name.
sql:
WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, STRFTIME('%Y-%m', payment_date) as month, SUM(amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id, STRFTIME('%Y-%m', payment_date)
),
monthly_with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month,
        monthly_total,
        LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as prev_month_total,
        monthly_total - LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as month_change
    FROM monthly_totals
),
avg_monthly_change AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        AVG(month_change) as avg_monthly_change
    FROM monthly_with_lag
    WHERE month_change IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    amc.avg_monthly_change
FROM avg_monthly_change amc
JOIN customer c ON amc.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY amc.avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 1
